Verse of the Day
Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the Lord, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
Amos 5:14
Quote of the Day
"Let us see and walk together in His love so He can abide with and in us, and we in Him."
Elder Gerrit W. Gong | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
